description: Unit test class for OpenConnectionResponse, testing JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and resource path correctness.

classes.name: OpenConnectionResponseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for OpenConnectionResponse, verifying equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that OpenConnectionResponse satisfies equality and hash code contracts using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that OpenConnectionResponse instances are immutable and that ConnectionId is also immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an OpenConnectionResponse with a null ConnectionId throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the fromJson method correctly deserializes a known JSON into an OpenConnectionResponse object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method correctly serializes an OpenConnectionResponse to its JSON representation.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the resource path returned by getResourcePath() is as expected.
